historyTimeline.h2: Land Rover Discovery D250 - Engine History & Specs at a Glance
historyTimeline.intro: When the D250 variant was introduced to the modern L462 Land Rover Discovery lineup, it brought the efficient 2.0-litre Ingenium diesel engine to the large 7-seat SUV, offering an optimal balance of daily drivability, fuel economy, and substantial towing torque.

milestones.description: 204DTD (2.0L Diesel), 249PS, introduced as the entry-to-mid-level diesel option for the all-new L462 Discovery, replacing the larger V6 diesels in lower trims to meet stricter emissions targets.

Facelift update introduces 48V Mild Hybrid Electric Vehicle (MHEV) technology to the D250 powertrain, improving stop-start refinement and providing a slight torque fill, though the core 204DTD architecture remains.

historyTimeline.closingNote: Every engine fitted to the Land Rover Discovery D250 is covered below, with UK rebuilt pricing and known failure points.

problems.h4: Timing Chain Tensioner Wear - Why the Land Rover Discovery D250 204DTD Suffers Premature Rattle
problems.affectedModels: Land Rover Discovery D250 (204DTD, 2017-present, highest risk pre-2019)
problems.rootCause: Early-production tensioner designs are prone to premature wear under the high load of a heavy 7-seat SUV, leading to chain stretch, rattle on cold starts, and potential catastrophic valve-to-piston contact if ignored.

repairOptions.whatItInvolves: Installing an updated OEM-spec timing chain kit with a revised, more robust tensioner.
repairOptions.longevity: Highly recommended preventative measure for pre-2019 models approaching 60k miles.

repairOptions.whatItInvolves: Supply & fit, upgraded components addressing the original failure point, 12-month warranty.
repairOptions.longevity: The right call if the chain has already jumped or secondary internal damage has occurred.

problems.recommendation: For pre-2019 D250 units, a preventative timing chain upgrade is strongly advised to mitigate known risks. However, if chain rattle, oil dilution warnings, or knocking noises are already present, a full rebuilt engine with upgraded internals offers the best long-term reliability and protects your significant vehicle investment.

problems.h4: Oil Dilution & EGR Cooler Leaks - Why the Land Rover Discovery D250 204DTD Loses Oil Integrity
problems.rootCause: Frequent short-trip urban driving triggers incomplete DPF regenerations, washing unburnt fuel into the crankcase. Combined with EGR cooler micro-leaks, this leads to oil dilution, sludge buildup, and accelerated bearing wear.

repairOptions.whatItInvolves: Full oil and filter change with engine flush, plus PCV valve inspection and EGR cleaning.
repairOptions.longevity: Viable only if caught early with no bearing knock or severe sludge formation.

repairOptions.whatItInvolves: Supply & fit, upgraded components addressing the original failure point, 12-month warranty.
repairOptions.longevity: Necessary if oil analysis shows significant fuel contamination or bearing wear is confirmed.
